title: Prioritize Sleep Hygiene
description: Quality sleep helps regulate emotional health and improves stress resilience.
actionable_tip: Aim for 7-9 hours per night. Keep your room dark and cool, and turn off screens 1 hour before bed.

title: Practice Box Breathing
description: Deep breathing helps activate the parasympathetic nervous system to reduce anxiety.
actionable_tip: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds. Repeat 4 times.

title: Stay Hydrated
description: Dehydration can lead to fatigue, irritability, and brain fog.
actionable_tip: Drink at least 64 oz of water daily and keep a water bottle near your desk.

title: Daily Gratitude Practice
description: Focusing on positive aspects of your day increases overall well-being and serotonin.
actionable_tip: Write down 3 specific things you are grateful for each morning or evening.

title: Daily Movement
description: Regular physical activity releases endorphins and reduces stress hormones.
actionable_tip: Take a 20-30 minute walk outdoors or engage in mild stretching or yoga.

title: Reach Out to Friends
description: Connecting with a supportive network buffers against feeling isolated.
actionable_tip: Schedule a call, message a close friend, or grab coffee with a colleague.

title: Take Social Media Breaks
description: Constant screen time and news consumption can elevate anxiety levels.
actionable_tip: Set daily app limits or take a 24-hour break from social media over the weekend.

title: Practice Grace
description: Negative self-talk escalates stress and feelings of inadequacy.
actionable_tip: Reframe negative thoughts by asking: 'Would I say this to a friend in my situation?'
